acceptedAnswer.text: Logo design itself, which NayaDaur Digital can do separately. Guarantees of acceptance. Registration in other countries.

mainEntity.name: Why register a trademark?

acceptedAnswer.text: It gives you a stronger, clearer legal position against copycats than relying on use alone, and it is a real asset if you sell or franchise your brand.

mainEntity.name: Can I register a logo and a name?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. They can be registered separately or together. Shine advises which route suits your brand.

mainEntity.name: Does registration work outside Pakistan?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Trademark rights are territorial. If you sell abroad, ask about filings in those countries.

mainEntity.name: Is acceptance guaranteed?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. The office may raise objections, for example if a similar mark exists. A search first reduces that risk.

mainEntity.name: Do I need a trademark if I already have a business registration?

acceptedAnswer.text: Registering a business is a different process. A trademark protects your brand name and logo as identifiers of your goods or services. Ask a lawyer how both fit together for your business.

mainEntity.name: Can I register my logo and my name together?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. They can be registered separately or together. A lawyer can advise which route suits your brand.

mainEntity.name: Does a Pakistani trademark protect me abroad?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Trademark rights are territorial. If you sell in other countries, ask about registering there as well.
